name_note: Most genomes GTDB places here carry the NCBI name Faecalibacterium prausnitzii; Faecalibacterium hattorii was separated from F. prausnitzii in a genome-based re-evaluation.

sentences.text: Faecalibacterium hattorii was proposed as a novel species of the genus Faecalibacterium, with type strain JCM 39210, in a re-evaluation of strains deposited as Faecalibacterium prausnitzii.
That re-evaluation describes Faecalibacterium prausnitzii as one of the most important butyrate-producing bacteria in the human gut.
Faecalibacterium hattorii APC922/41-1 was among the closest neighbours of two obligately anaerobic, butyrate-producing strains isolated from faecal samples of healthy Taiwanese adults.
